inputs.name: atomicSyntax.content
inputs.description: Svelte source text passed to parse with { modern: true }. The function does not catch parse failures.

inputs.name: walkAtomicMarkup.node
inputs.description: An object subtree or array of subtrees that the walker inspects. Falsy and non-object values are ignored; traversal skips keys parent, metadata, expression, and attributes, and it has no general cycle guard.

inputs.name: walkAtomicMarkup.callback
inputs.description: A synchronous function called with each visited object whose type property is truthy. It is not called for untyped values, and any exception it throws propagates.

outputs.name: atomicSyntax
outputs.type: { tree: AST.Root; directory?: string; tier?: string; element?: string; atoms: Array<{ node: AST.RegularElement; definition?: { name: string; tag: string; type?: string } }> }
outputs.description: An object containing the Svelte parse tree, the first matching top-level @harness-atoms, valid @harness-tier, and @harness-element values, and atoms entries for hx- regular elements. Header values are undefined when no matching top-level comment exists, and an atom entry's definition is undefined when no native definition matches.

outputs.name: walkAtomicMarkup
outputs.description: The function has no return statement and therefore completes with undefined after traversal. Exceptions raised during traversal propagate to the caller.

errors.name: parser exception
errors.description: The imported Svelte parser's exception passes through if parse(content, { modern: true }) fails. atomicSyntax does not catch or transform it.

errors.name: callback exception
errors.description: An exception thrown by callback while visiting a node passes through unchanged. The walker does not catch or transform it.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Calling a non-callable callback on a visited node raises a TypeError. This occurs only if traversal reaches an object with a truthy type property.
